text:
Born destitute, he is the Lord of the three worlds and the master of all wealth, beyond the reach of the ancestral abode. He is called Shiva, the one of terrifying form; yet there are none who truly know the reality of the wielder of the Pinaka bow.

Whether he shines with ornaments, or wears tight garments, or is draped in an elephant skin, or wears silk, or is the skull-bearer, or is crowned by the crescent moon—the form of the Universal Being cannot be defined.
